entities.name: Shah Abbas Mosque (Keshla)
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Shah Abbas Mosque is a mosque in the Keshla settlement of the Nizami district of Baku, Azerbaijan. The mosque of Keshla village is a monument of the 17th century and was built by the order of the Safavid Persian king Shah Abbas.
